card.line: Spain was a far western land where Paul hoped to preach the gospel, a plan he shared with the church in Rome.

moments.title: Paul plans to visit Spain
moments.text: Paul tells the believers in Rome that he hopes to see them on his way to Spain. He hopes they will equip him for the journey after he enjoys their company for a while.

moments.title: Spain after Jerusalem
moments.text: Paul first must take a gift to the poor saints in Jerusalem. After he delivers it safely, he says he will set off to Spain by way of Rome.
